the daily forecast. While weather can shift dramatically from one day to the next, the climate of an area describes what is normal over decades.

tasks.analysis: Climate change has become one of the most pressing current issues of our time, sparking global conversations, When discussing climate,it is often confused with weather. Climate specifically refers to long-term trends in temperature, humidity, wind , and precipitation that define typical conditions for a region-not just the daily forecast.
